gr_list.description: Agent leaderboard models + InsightRepository agent methods (upsert + read + delete)

plan.summary: RI-3.3 Agent Leaderboard engine: compute per-agent metrics (total_conversations, sale_count, offered_count, conversion_rate, avg_response_time_ms, ghost_rate, weighted_score) by joining MSSQL Chats.OwnerUserID+Users with PG wa_conversation_outcomes+wa_response_times, and expose via POST compute + GET read endpoints.
plan.q_intent: RI Faz 3 Paket 2: Agent Leaderboard. POST+GET pattern, wa_agent_metrics tablosu mevcut. Agent sahibi = Chats.OwnerUserID (MSSQL direkt).
plan.interview_notes: Agent mapping: Chats.OwnerUserID (not first-responder). IsBotUser=0 filter. ghost_rate = outcome-based (no_response/total). weighted_score = conversion(50%)+response_time(30%)+ghost_rate_inverse(20%), quality deferred to RI-3.7. MSSQL direkt (not INMA API). AC4: weighted_score ordering verified.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: POST /api/ops/insights/compute/agent-leaderboard returns 200, computes agent metrics from MSSQL Chats.OwnerUserID+Users, writes results to wa_agent_metrics in PostgreSQL
GET /api/ops/insights/agent-leaderboard/{tenantId} returns JSON with agent list ordered by weighted_score DESC, including conversion_rate, avg_response_time_ms, ghost_rate
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: GET returns 15 agents with all fields, ordered by weighted_score DESC (100→27.7).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: EbruModa (tenant_id=5051, database=WaClientEbruModa) successful compute cycle produces at least 2 agent metrics
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: 15 agent metrics produced. 3 MSSQL instances (5521, 6473, 5538). Turkish chars correct (zübeyde, Aşlar, Tuğçe).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Agents are correctly ordered by weighted_score (highest conversion agent has highest or near-highest score)
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: 100% conversion agents = score 100 (top). Aşlar 66.7% conv = 82.8. Admin 41% conv + slow RT = 40.1. Tuğçe 16.7% + slowest = 27.7 (bottom). Ordering correct.

files_changed.change: Add agent leaderboard DTOs and record models

verification_questions.question: Does the MSSQL query correctly use Chats.OwnerUserID joined with Users to identify chat owners, filtering IsBotUser=0?
verification_questions.codex_answer: SQL selects C.OwnerUserID and joins Users U on U.ID = C.OwnerUserID with filter U.IsBotUser = 0

verification_questions.question: Is the ops-level X-Ops-Key authentication applied to both POST compute and GET leaderboard endpoints?
verification_questions.codex_answer: Both endpoints call ValidateOpsKey(ctx) and return 401 on failure

verification_questions.question: Does the weighted_score formula correctly use conversion(50%)+response_time_score(30%)+ghost_rate_inverse(20%) with normalized inputs?
verification_questions.codex_answer: Weights 0.50/0.30/0.20 defined as constants. CalculateWeightedScore normalizes all inputs to 0-100 scale

verification_questions.question: Are agent metrics upserted (not duplicated) on repeated compute calls, using ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, instance_id, agent_id)?
verification_questions.codex_answer: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, instance_id, agent_id) DO UPDATE with all metric fields

intentional_exclusions: Quality component in weighted_score (deferred to RI-3.7)
Sector-specific agent benchmarks (deferred to Faz 3 completion)

try_catch_locations: Program.cs: POST endpoint — top-level error handler
user_facing_errors: INV-WA-020: Insight compute failed — MSSQL connection error
INV-WA-021: No classified outcomes for tenant
INV-WA-022: Agent leaderboard data not found for tenant
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: All errors logged via JsonLinesLogger. MSSQL failures throw SqlException caught at batch level. PG failures throw at upsert level. Both caught at endpoint with ErrorResponse.

aha_moments.user_pain: Tenant hangi agent'in iyi sattigini bilmiyor, sadece hissiyata dayanarak degerlendiriyor
aha_moments.suggestion: Agent leaderboard'da conversion_rate + weighted_score ile objektif siralama goster
aha_moments.aha_moment: Tenant ilk kez 'Mehmet %28 conversion, Ahmet %8 — Mehmet'in yontemlerini ogrenelim' diyor

aha_moments.user_pain: Agent performansi icin birden fazla raporu birlesik okumak gerekiyor
aha_moments.suggestion: Tek endpoint'te tum metrikler: conversion, response time, ghost rate, weighted score
aha_moments.aha_moment: Bir bakista hangi agent'in nerede iyi/kotu oldugu goruluyor — ayri ayri tablolara bakma yok

aha_moments.user_pain: Ops ekibi hangi agent'larin egitim gerektirdigini tespit edemiyor
aha_moments.suggestion: Ghost rate + dusuk conversion flag'i ile 'dikkat gerektiren agent' tespiti
aha_moments.aha_moment: Ops 'Bu agent %45 ghost rate ile konusmalari kaybediyor' goruyorsa proaktif aksiyon alabilir

aha_moments.user_pain: Agent bazli response time analizi icin MSSQL sorgulari dakikalar surebilir
aha_moments.suggestion: wa_response_times tablosundan zaten hesaplanmis response time'lari kullan, MSSQL'den sadece agent mapping cek
aha_moments.aha_moment: Compute saniyeler icinde donuyor — RI-3.1'in onceden hesapladigi response time'lar reuse ediliyor

aha_moments.user_pain: Bazi konusmalarda OwnerUserID NULL olabilir (atanmamis chat'ler)
aha_moments.suggestion: OwnerUserID IS NOT NULL filtresi + unassigned konusma sayisini loglama
aha_moments.aha_moment: Rapor sadece atanmis konusmalari gosteriyor, atanmamis olanlar ayrica loglanarak ops'a gorulur hale geliyor
